{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]] | [[Cookbook:Pie Crust|Pie Crust]]

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (150 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (2.5 g) [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 10 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] (128 g) solid vegetable [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* ½ tsp (2.5 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) distilled white [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
* 2 tbsp (30 ml) cold [[Cookbook:Water|water]]

==Procedure==
# Mix flour and salt. Cut shortening into the flour/salt mixture with a [[Cookbook:Pastry Cutter|pastry cutter]], until mixture resembles the texture of tiny [[Cookbook:Pea|peas]].
# In separate bowl, [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] the egg, vinegar and water until well mixed.
# Drizzle water/egg mixture into flour mixture. Stir with fork until a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] is formed.
# Gather dough into a ball, flatten into a 10 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] (4-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]) wide disk. Wrap in [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic]], and refrigerate 30 minutes.
# [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll]] dough into 20 cm (9-inch) circle and fit into a 20 cm (9-inch) [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]].
# Line the unbaked [[Cookbook:Pie Crust|pie shell]] with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] or [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]], and fill with dried [[Cookbook:Bean|beans]] or [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 220°C (425°F) until light golden brown (about 15–18 minutes).
# Cool before filling.

==Recipes using this crust==
*[[Cookbook:Banana_Cream_Pie|Banana Cream Pie]]
*[[Cookbook:Lemon Meringue Pie (American)|Lemon Meringue Pie (American)]]
